commits.message:
Fix code that assumed only a single edge could exist between vertices.

Instead of iterating over neighbors and assuming the existence of a unique edge, iterate over the actual incident edges.
Allow loops and multiple edges in KontsevichGraph.

Re-implement KontsevichGraph.swap(internal_vertex).

The old implementation was incompatible with multiedges=True.
(It turned labels 'L', 'R' into the unhashable ['L'], ['R'].)

Switch to list notation for edges in examples.

This is shorter, and prepares for the switch to multiedges=True.
Add 'upright' keyword argument to KontsevichGraph.plot().
Allow vertex label normalization of immutable graphs, through an inplace=False argument.
Add functions kontsevich_weight and kontsevich_star_product_terms.
Fix typos in KontsevichGraphSeries doctests.
Add type-check to KontsevichGraph equality testing.
In KontsevichGraph.add_wedge and KontsevichGraphSum.self_action, allow for a wedge to be inserted (rather than added).
Extend KontsevichGraphSum.jacobiator to produce a Jacobiator on top of a given KontsevichGraph.
Add in_degrees() and __getitem__() to KontsevichGraphSum to select terms by in-degree of the ground vertices.
Remove print statements in KontsevichGraphSum.hochschild_differential (leftover from debugging).
Add weight_integrand method to KontsevichGraph.
Add construction of a Kontsevich graph from a LaTeX expression for a multi-differential operator. Fix _latex_ method to produce fewer spaces, for compatibility with this new constructor.
Fix missing space in error message.
Add _latex_ method to KontsevichGraph; add corresponding indices (boolean) argument to plot/show methods.
Fix comment about multiple edges in KontsevichGraphSum's self_action method.
Add jacobiator method to KontsevichGraphSums.
Add add_wedge method to KontsevichGraph and self_action method to KontsevichGraphSum.
Fix KontsevichGraph multiplicity, and add a test that shows it has been fixed.
Fix construction of KontsevichGraphSeries from KontsevichGraph.
Clarify the meaning of KontsevichGraphSeries' gauge_transform, and make the code more readable.
Add shorthand notation for KontsevichGraphs consisting of just ground vertices.
Add constructor for KontsevichGraphSum from KontsevichGraph (with coefficient 1), and similarly constructors for KontsevichGraphSeries from KontsevichGraph and KontsevichGraphSum.
Change order of KontsevichGrapSeries.gauge_transform to be more natural.
Add hochschild_differential() and pointwise product to KontsevichGraphSum.
Add kontsevich_graph_series() to KontsevichGraphSeriesRng.
Add inverse() and gauge_transform() to KontsevichGraphSeries.
Generalize KontsevichGraphSeries.subs(). Allow attachment of a single graph to a graph with a single ground vertex, to make this work in that case.
Add base_module() to KontsevichGraphSeriesRng.
Refactor KontsevichGraphSeries' star product _mul_(self, other) into substitution subs(self, *args).
Simplify common_prec() in KontsevichGraphSeries: the case of a set containing infinity is already handled by min(), so we need not make exceptions.
Initial KontsevichGraphSeries implementation.
Add __len__ method to KontsevichGraphSum.
Make KontsevichGraphSum iterable, yielding (coefficient, graph) terms.
Add coefficient() and coefficients() methods to KontsevichGraphSum.
Fix regression that broke KontsevichGraph's attach(): now use DiGraph's union(), in light of the recent change to KontsevichGraph's union().
Fix ground vertices in mirror_image so that their ordering remains unchanged; this also fixes some sign errors.

Fix KontsevichGraph's union(self, other) to choose ground vertices properly, asserting self.ground_vertices() == other.ground_vertices(). The use of set() before this change would sometimes put the ground vertices in an incorrect order, leading to sign errors.
Make kontsevich_graphs generator more flexible by accepting for positive_differential_order the values None, True and False.
Fix regression introduced by changing list of ground vertices into tuple: they are now returned by ground_vertices() in the correct order.
Change KontsevichGraph's multiplicity() to double-count some edge labelings.
Add edge_multiplicity() and internal_vertex_multiplicity() to KontsevichGraph, and let multiplicity() be their product.
Remove some unnecessary references to DiGraph.
Show edge labels by default in both show() and plot() of KontsevichGraph.
Implement the iterated Leibniz rule in KontsevichGraphSum's subs() properly, and (by necessity) make graph attachment more flexible.
Don't apply Leibniz rule to operator of differential order 0.
Add ground_vertices argument to kontsevich_graphs generator.
Implement unequality test by negating result of equality test.
Improve kontsevich_graphs generator to yield KontsevichGraphs with 0 internal vertices, and to start construction in general from a single KontsevichGraph (with ground vertices already in place).
Add subs() method to KontsevichGraphSum, to substitute KontsevichGraphSums into the ground vertices of another.

Let attach() in KontsevichGraph copy the labels (which were missing before) of edges coming into ground vertices. Also get labels to show up even more often, e.g. in the notebook without calling show().
Add attach() method to KontsevichGraph.
Refactor edge_relabelings of KontsevichGraph by adding a swap method, which is also useful to have public.
Add example to kontsevich_graphs generator.

Add mirror_image() method to KontsevichGraph, add modulo_mirror_images option to kontsevich_graphs generator. Change from only_{primes,nonzero} options of kontsevich_graphs to something more flexible: the new options prime and zero can be None (indifferent, default), True or False.
Add only_nonzero option to kontsevich_graphs generator.

Rectified omission of the word 'not', which changes the meaning of a statement rather drastically (the previous commit erroneously made almost all KontsevichGraphSums equal to zero).
Note to self: don't commit in the early AM.
Handle graphs which are zero as sums, because they have an equal relabeling with opposite sign.
Preserve ordering of terms in KontsevichGraphSum's reduce() method.
Explain the quotient (swap L and R -> minus sign) in KontsevichGraphSum.
Add some newlines: breathing room (and standards compliance).
Implement proper equality testing for KontsevichGraphSums, taking signs (from edge swapping) into account.
Handle cancelling/zeros correctly in KontsevichGraphSum's reduce().
Change KontsevichGraphSum equality to be a reasonable thing: equality of coefficients of equal graphs.
Add doctest for equalities involving powers of KontsevichGraphs.
Never allow multiple edges in KontsevichGraphs. This fixes equality testing of powers, e.g. KG^1 == KG now, whereas this didn't work before.
Powers of immutable KontsevichGraphs are immutable.
Make _an_element_() of KontsevichGraphSums slightly less trivial.
Now at most 80 characters per line in kontsevich_graph_sum.py.
Add basic docstrings and representation to KontsevichGraphSums.
Add basic reduction (collecting terms) and representation (for printing) to KontsevichGraphSum.
ValueError in KontsevichGraph should be TypeError.
Implement basic type checking for KontsevichGraphSum.
Implement bare-bones KontsevichGraphSums as a module.
Import generator kontsevich_graph into SAGE, and use the copy *method* of DiGraph in it, instead of the generic copy function which was not even imported.
Make a SAGE package, and ignore *.pyc (created by SAGE) in the repository.
Fit code in 80 characters per line.
Improve docstring wording: "Return ..." instead of "Returns ..."
Fix typo in example: empty tuple is ().
Ground vertices of KontsevichGraphs are now given by a tuple.
Make products of immutable KontsevichGraphs immutable.

Added __hash__ to KontsevichGraph so they can be properly used in containers such as set. Related to this, added multiplicity() to KontsevichGraph and the argument `unique' to the generator kontsevich_graphs.
Documentation for arguments n, m to kontsevich_graphs.
Add generator kontsevich_graphs for KontsevichGraphs.
Fixed implementation of immutability of KontsevichGraphs.
Improved some KontsevichGraph docstrings.
Implemented multiplication, powers, prime factorization and primality testing of Kontsevich graphs.
Implemented proper equality testing for Kontsevich graphs.
Added internal_vertices method to KontsevichGraph to complement ground_vertices.
Changed extension to .py so documentation can be built.

Added basic documentation for __init__, ground_vertices, show and union.
Fixed a bug that was revealed by testing ground_vertices. Now in
ground_vertices all vertices are first set to None.

Merge pull request #1 from rburing/kontsevich_graph

Initial KontsevichGraph with basic functionality: ordered ground vertices.
Initial KontsevichGraph with basic functionality: ordered ground vertices.
Initial commit
Penkava-Vanhaecke deformations, add data files
Obstruction to a loopless star-product, data files

Fix bug in reading series from file

Files containing several lines of the form "h^k:" with the same number k (which is rare, but can happen e.g. when concatenating) were not read correctly.
Add symmetrize command-line program
